info.title: CareerPilot Interview API
info.description: REST API for CareerPilot Interview by CodeBegun. Versioned endpoints live under /api/v1. Successful responses are `{ data }`; errors are `{ error: { code, message, details?, requestId } }`.

refreshCookie.name: cbi_rt
refreshCookie.description: httpOnly refresh cookie (`cbi_rt` / `cbi_admin_rt`; `__Secure-` prefix over HTTPS). Requests must also send `X-CB-CSRF: 1`.
